affectedPublicSurfaces: Celery beat task: /workers/tasks/impact_reader — daily impact readings computation
No API changes; only the internal work pattern changes from fleet-wide (system_scope) to per-tenant loop

journeys.name: impact-reader-enumerates-via-security-definer-and-loops-per-tenant
journeys.entryUrl: pytest on #1483's two-tenant fixture, as juli_app
assertions: the task acts on both tenants' executions
the per-item context is the item's shop, not one shop for the whole run
it does NOT act on rows that don't qualify (fixture seeds qualifying and non-qualifying)
readings are written under the correct shop scope

journeys.name: system_scope-exemption-shrinks
journeys.entryUrl: grep for system_scope() call sites and test_system_scope_call_sites_enumerated
assertions: impact_reader.py is removed from the expected call sites
the list has NOT grown — only shrinkage is acceptable in this epic
no other beat task incorrectly added system_scope

journeys.name: idempotency-preserved
journeys.entryUrl: pytest: run the task twice on identical state
assertions: second run writes zero new readings (idempotent)
no errors or duplicate key violations
the pre-write existence checks still guard against duplicates

migrationCompatibility.notes: No migration in this slice. The enumeration function was added in #1487 (migration 051). This slice only rewires the task to call it and loop with per-tenant context.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: task reverts to system_scope and full ORM reads. Slightly less efficient, still correct for the owner-bypass runtime. On the new juli_app runtime post-#1339, reverting this breaks the task entirely.

doNotInfer: Do not use system_scope. The task must loop, setting with_shop_scope for each execution's shop.
'Completed without raising' is not evidence. A successful no-op is the exact failure mode ADR-089 exists for — the task finishes, logs success, does nothing.
Do not fetch payload_json and tool_name in the cross-tenant read. Those are per-execution values, fetched under shop context after the loop has enumerated.
Do not omit impact_reader.py from the system_scope call sites. If you leave it there, the test regression-checks against it will pass silently.
Do not weaken or delete the existing per-execution idempotency checks. They stay — load_written_kinds and load_existing_metric_pairs guard against duplicates.
Do not test against SQLite. The test must run on real Postgres with SET ROLE juli_app and RLS policies enforced.
